properties.description:
The Windows browser-test process intermittently exited with native code 0xC0000409 in different tests. Earlier overnight investigations collected evidence but did not fix it; the separate authentication shutdown fix was unrelated.

Confirmed cause: full checkpoint run-I19aUC reproduced the crash during component-gallery-ui.spec.ts. External ProcDump and matching official Node 24.15.0 symbols resolved __report_gsfailure -> uv__tcp_connect -> node::TCPWrap::Connect. libuv passed RtlGetVersion an OSVERSIONINFOW with an uninitialized size. The dump contains size 300 instead of 276 and an adjacent stack cookie overwritten with 0x0001030000000000. This matches https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/62561 and https://github.com/libuv/libuv/pull/5107, first included in Node 24.16.0. The earlier dismissal of this source-code lead was incorrect.

Fix: the root package owns exact Node 24.22.1. npm scripts and start.ps1 select it locally; startup/checks reject a different runtime and descendants inherit the selected executable. The machine-wide runtime is unchanged. Postinstall relinks npm's Windows shell shims from the installed executable metadata: an exact regression caught PowerShell otherwise selecting an empty placeholder. Temporary in-process diagnostic hooks were removed.

Historical crash locations and measured passing test-body times:
- context-chat-ui.spec.ts — sending from default buildspace chat creates a real conversation with a feed result: 4,655 ms.
- mvp-node-editor-ui.spec.ts — independent repeated components keep their own property values and definitions in the planning editor: 5,116–6,220 ms.
- component-gallery-ui.spec.ts — components use the shared repository tree and generic Visual preview: 7,019 ms.
- ui-editor-ui.spec.ts — submitted review Changes keeps Repositories and the selected component editor: 16,997–18,640 ms.
Zero-duration crash reports do not measure execution time. Historical reports: .harness/overnight-third-full-browser-results-20261024.json, splitter-full-browser-results.json and overnight-final-isolation-results-20261024.json.

Experiments: 100 same-worker chat repetitions, 100 fresh-worker repetitions and 40 mixed cases passed on the affected runtime; those 240 passes did not prove a fix. The subsequent complete workload captured the native crash. All 40 mixed repetitions passed on checksum-verified Node 24.16.0. On pinned 24.22.1, all six runtime/runner tests and nine affected application checks pass. Complete run-PMHhAv passed 676 non-browser tests and 330/331 browser tests with no native crash; its sole failure was a toolbar measurement race, separately corrected under check reliability.

Evidence: .harness/native-worker-experiments-20261025.json; native-root-cause-20261025.json; dump and exact symbols/disassembly/fields in native-worker-checkpoint-final-v2-20261025/; native-fixed-node-20261025.log; runtime-shell-before.actual.json and .expected.json; runtime-focused-after-20261025.log and runtime-integration-after-20261025.log. All paths are under .harness/. Dumps remain local.

Completed in 98fd68c. Final checkpoint .harness/checkpoints/run-RPaAAX/report.json passed in 38.34 minutes: 676 model/unit/tooling tests, 331 browser tests, zero failures and zero native crashes. Type, organisation, boundary and build checks passed. Source hashes remained unchanged throughout verification. Completion receipt: .harness/queued-work-completion-20261025.json. Changes are committed on codex/queued-work; the worktree is clean and the managed app is running on Node 24.22.1.
properties.title: Diagnose and fix intermittent Windows browser-test worker crashes
